meta.name: bats-testing-patterns
meta.description: Master Bash Automated Testing System (Bats) for comprehensive shell script testing. Use when writing tests for shell scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or requiring test-driven development of shell utilities.

copy.tagline: 为命令行脚本搭建自动化测试,改动前自动验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常写或维护 shell 脚本,担心改错影响线上任务。
copy.tagline_en: Write automated tests for your shell scripts and verify before changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain shell scripts and want to catch issues before they break live tasks.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 Bats 测试模式指导你为 Shell 脚本写单元测试,涵盖断言、setup/teardown、mock、fixture 及错误场景等写法,并给出示例代码。
howto.when: 当你说要写 Shell 脚本测试、涉及 CI/CD 流水线测试,或要求对 Shell 工具做测试驱动开发时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Bats 给这个 shell 脚本写单元测试
say.note: Claude 会给出测试文件与断言示例。

say.text: 给 script.sh 写带 setup/teardown 和 mock 的测试
say.note: 将生成对应的测试代码。

say.text: 把这个 Bats 测试接入 GitHub Actions
say.note: 会给出 CI 配置示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Bats patterns to help you write unit tests for shell scripts, covering assertions, setup/teardown, mocks, fixtures, error scenarios, and provides runnable examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write tests for shell scripts, set up CI/CD pipeline tests, or request test-driven development of shell utilities.

say_en.text: Help me write Bats unit tests for this shell script
say_en.note: Claude provides test file and assertion examples.

say_en.text: Write tests with setup/teardown and mocks for script.sh
